text:
Wow, a driver's medical certificate costs 500 baht.
When I walked in, I immediately asked the receptionist how much it was. As best I could understand Thai English, it was 100 baht (the same as I always paid before). They took my blood pressure and listened to my heart. Then they said 500 baht. You heard the doctor himself!!

500 baht for a driver's medical certificate - crazy!!
